invariant: NoCompletedJobWithCancelledTasks: A job may transition to completed only if all tasks completed; cancelled tasks must never be masked as completed
preconditions: Multi-task or single-task job where at least one task is cancelled via cancelTask and remaining tasks complete or none fail
sequence: 1. runJob 2. task 1 finishes or running 3. cancelTask(jobId task2) 4. activeTasks drops to 0 allFinished is true anyFailed is false 5. finishJob('completed') called
alloy_verdict: COUNTEREXAMPLE (SAT in mutant; UNSAT in hardened)
patch: Check anyCancelled in doPump termination logic and finishJob('cancelled') instead of finishJob('completed')
post_fix_evidence: 7/7 tests pass in terminalMonotonicityHardening.test.ts; 54/54 core orchestrator/lifecycle tests pass
limitations: Scope bounded to in-memory and local execution graphs

invariant: TaskTerminalMonotonicity: A task/node cancelled during placement/assignment cannot be transitioned to running
preconditions: Asynchronous assignTask in flight when cancelTask or cancelJob is invoked
sequence: 1. task selected from readyNodes 2. assignTask awaits worker 3. cancelTask sets node/task to cancelled 4. assignTask resolves 5. orchestrator unconditionally updates node to running 6. assertNodeTransition throws InvalidStatusTransitionError uncaught
expected: Clean cancellation without uncaught InvalidStatusTransitionError (cancelled -> running)
observed: Uncaught InvalidStatusTransitionError: Invalid node status transition for '...': cancelled -> running
patch: Check taskAbort.signal.aborted job.status node.state and task.status after assignTask and in catch block; abort dispatch if cancelled
post_fix_evidence: 7/7 tests pass in terminalMonotonicityHardening.test.ts; 54/54 core orchestrator/lifecycle tests pass
limitations: Placement engine must release reserved worker slots if dispatch is aborted

invariant: NoTaskRetryOnCancelledJob: When a job is cancelled no task within it may be retried or transitioned back to pending
preconditions: In-flight task fails or throws after job was cancelled via jobManager.cancel or cancelJob
sequence: 1. Job cancelled via jobManager.cancel 2. In-flight task executor returns failure 3. retry branch checks retries < maxRetries 4. orchestrator attempts updateTaskStatus(job.id taskId 'pending') 5. assertTaskTransition throws InvalidStatusTransitionError (cancelled -> pending)
expected: Task execution aborts cleanly without scheduling retries on cancelled job
observed: Throws uncaught InvalidStatusTransitionError: cancelled -> pending; attempts to resurrect task on cancelled job
patch: Check isCancelled guard (checking job/task cancellation and cancelledTaskIds) before entering retry branches
post_fix_evidence: 7/7 tests pass in terminalMonotonicityHardening.test.ts; 54/54 core orchestrator/lifecycle tests pass
limitations: Orphaned worker recovery specifically allowed to retry when job is active and task is not explicitly cancelled

invariant: TerminalMonotonicity: Proactive tasks in terminal state (completed cancelled failed) cannot be resurrected or triggered
preconditions: Proactive task has reached completed cancelled or failed state
sequence: 1. Proactive task cancelled via cancelTask 2. Late callback or external loop calls updateStatus(taskId 'running') or recordTrigger(taskId) 3. Task status flips back to running or completed
expected: Terminal tasks reject status resurrection and ignore triggers
observed: Task resurrected from cancelled to running; triggerCount mutated and status flipped to completed
patch: Added TERMINAL_PROACTIVE_STATUS guard in updateStatus recordTrigger and cancelTask
limitations: In-memory proactive task manager only; does not affect distributed KV-persisted task records
